title: Changing insight list ordering requires updating ambr query snapshot
answers: test_insight.ambr snapshot fails after changing insight list ORDER BY
Which files change when insight list default order changes
body:
The SQL of the unordered insight list is snapshotted in products/product_analytics/backend/tests/api/__snapshots__/test_insight.ambr (the `ORDER BY` clause before `LIMIT 100`). Changing `order_queryset` in products/product_analytics/backend/presentation/insight.py requires updating that snapshot (e.g. `last_modified_at DESC, id DESC`).
Also, no test previously asserted default list order. Add one like test_list_without_order_sorts_by_last_modified_at_descending in products/product_analytics/backend/tests/api/test_insight.py. It sets `order` values opposite to the expected sort so it fails under the old default.
applies: Any change to default insight list ordering or its query shape
says: Insight list snapshot test fails after changing the default sort
Changing insight default ranking breaks test assertions about ordering
Insight test snapshot doesn't match the new default order
Where is the insight list default sort order implemented
How to fix insight list tests after updating the ranking
search: Changing the default insight list order in order_queryset (products/product_analytics/backend/presentation/insight.py) requires updating the SQL snapshot in test_insight.ambr (the ORDER BY clause before LIMIT 100) and adding a regression test in test_insight.py that asserts the new default order by using opposite order values that fail under the old default. The snapshot mechanism captures the full query shape, so any ordering change must be reflected there. Applies to changes in default insight list ordering or its query structure in the insight API.
